typeSystemDescription.name: TexttechnologyCohMetrix
typeSystemDescription.description: Type system for Coh-Metrix indices and index groups.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.Index
typeDescription.description: Stores one Coh-Metrix index result and its labels, value, diagnostic, and implementation version.

featureDescription.name: value
featureDescription.description: Calculated index value or NaN if undefined.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DescriptiveIndex
typeDescription.description: Describes basic counts and length distributions of paragraphs, sentences, words, syllables, and characters.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DESPC
typeDescription.description: Reports the number of non-empty paragraphs in the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DESSC
typeDescription.description: Reports the number of non-empty sentences in the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DESWC
typeDescription.description: Reports the number of words in the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DESPL
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean number of sentences per paragraph.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DESPLd
typeDescription.description: Reports the standard deviation of sentence counts across non-empty paragraphs.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DESSL
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean sentence length in words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DESSLd
typeDescription.description: Reports the standard deviation of word counts across non-empty sentences.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DESWLsy
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean number of syllables per word.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DESWLsyd
typeDescription.description: Reports the population standard deviation of syllable counts per word.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DESWLlt
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean number of characters per non-punctuation token.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DESWLltd
typeDescription.description: Reports the population standard deviation of character counts per non-punctuation token.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.TextEasabilityIndex
typeDescription.description: Represents the z-scores and percentiles of the Coh-Metrix text-easability principal components.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCNARz
typeDescription.description: Reports the z-score of the Text Easability narrativity component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCNARp
typeDescription.description: Reports the percentile of the Text Easability narrativity component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCSYNz
typeDescription.description: Reports the z-score of the Text Easability syntactic-simplicity component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCSYNp
typeDescription.description: Reports the percentile of the Text Easability syntactic-simplicity component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCCNCz
typeDescription.description: Reports the z-score of the Text Easability word-concreteness component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCCNCp
typeDescription.description: Reports the percentile of the Text Easability word-concreteness component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCREFz
typeDescription.description: Reports the z-score of the Text Easability referential-cohesion component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCREFp
typeDescription.description: Reports the percentile of the Text Easability referential-cohesion component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCDCz
typeDescription.description: Reports the z-score of the Text Easability deep-cohesion component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCDCp
typeDescription.description: Reports the percentile of the Text Easability deep-cohesion component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCVERBz
typeDescription.description: Reports the z-score of the Text Easability verb-cohesion component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCVERBp
typeDescription.description: Reports the percentile of the Text Easability verb-cohesion component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCCONNz
typeDescription.description: Reports the z-score of the Text Easability connectivity component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCCONNp
typeDescription.description: Reports the percentile of the Text Easability connectivity component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCTEMPz
typeDescription.description: Reports the z-score of the Text Easability temporality component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.PCTEMPp
typeDescription.description: Reports the percentile of the Text Easability temporality component.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.ReferentialCohesionIndex
typeDescription.description: Measures lexical and referential overlap across adjacent or non-adjacent sentences.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CRFNO1
typeDescription.description: Reports the proportion of adjacent sentence pairs that share at least one noun.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CRFAO1
typeDescription.description: Reports the proportion of adjacent sentence pairs that share at least one argument.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CRFSO1
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean binary stem overlap between adjacent sentences.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CRFNOa
typeDescription.description: Reports the proportion of all unordered sentence pairs that share at least one noun.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CRFAOa
typeDescription.description: Reports the proportion of all unordered sentence pairs that share at least one argument.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CRFSOa
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean binary stem overlap across all unordered sentence pairs in the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CRFCWO1
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean proportional content-word overlap between adjacent sentences.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CRFCWO1d
typeDescription.description: Reports the population standard deviation of the directed pair values available for CRFCWO1.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CRFCWOa
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean proportional content-word overlap across all unordered sentence pairs.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CRFCWOad
typeDescription.description: Reports the population standard deviation of the directed pair values available for CRFCWOa.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LsaIndex
typeDescription.description: Measures semantic overlap and given-new information using token-vector-based approximations.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LSASS1
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean semantic similarity between adjacent sentences.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LSASS1d
typeDescription.description: Reports the population standard deviation of valid cosine similarities between adjacent sentence vectors.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LSASSp
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean semantic similarity of all evaluable sentence pairs within the same paragraph.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LSASSpd
typeDescription.description: Reports the population standard deviation of the cosine similarities available for LSASSp.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LSAPP1
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean semantic similarity between adjacent paragraphs.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LSAPP1d
typeDescription.description: Reports the population standard deviation of valid cosine similarities between adjacent paragraph vectors.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LSAGN
typeDescription.description: Approximates each sentence's semantic given-new proportion relative to all preceding evaluable sentences.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LSAGNd
typeDescription.description: Reports the population standard deviation of the evaluable sentence-level given-new ratios.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LexicalDiversityIndex
typeDescription.description: Measures vocabulary variation using type-token ratio, MTLD, or VOCD.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LDTTRc
typeDescription.description: Reports the ratio of distinct content-word lemmas to the total number of content words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LDTTRa
typeDescription.description: Reports the ratio of distinct alphabetic word forms to the total number of alphabetic word tokens.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LDMTLDa
typeDescription.description: Reports the lexical diversity of the text as the Measure of Textual Lexical Diversity.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.LDVOCDa
typeDescription.description: Reports the lexical diversity of the text using the LexicalRichness VOCD method.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.ConnectivesIndex
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of connectives grouped by discourse-relation category.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CNCAll
typeDescription.description: Reports all accepted connective occurrences per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CNCCaus
typeDescription.description: Reports accepted causal connective occurrences per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CNCLogic
typeDescription.description: Reports accepted logical connective occurrences per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CNCADC
typeDescription.description: Reports accepted adversative or contrastive connective occurrences per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CNCTemp
typeDescription.description: Reports accepted temporal connective occurrences per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CNCTempx
typeDescription.description: Reports accepted expanded temporal connective occurrences per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CNCAdd
typeDescription.description: Reports accepted additive connective occurrences per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CNCPos
typeDescription.description: Reports accepted positive connective occurrences per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.CNCNeg
typeDescription.description: Reports accepted negative connective occurrences per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SituationModelIndex
typeDescription.description: Measures causal, intentional, semantic, and temporal cohesion between events and states.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SMCAUSv
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of causal verbs per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SMCAUSvp
typeDescription.description: Reports the combined incidence of causal verbs and causal particles per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SMINTEp
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of intentional verbs per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SMCAUSr
typeDescription.description: Reports the ratio of causal particles to causal verbs.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SMINTEr
typeDescription.description: Reports the ratio of intentional purpose particles to intentional verbs.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SMCAUSlsa
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean semantic similarity of all unordered verb pairs in the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SMCAUSwn
typeDescription.description: Reports the proportion of evaluable unordered verb pairs that share at least one synset.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SMTEMP
typeDescription.description: Measures order-sensitive temporal cohesion through tense and aspect agreement between adjacent sentences.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SyntacticComplexityIndex
typeDescription.description: Measures left-embeddedness, noun-phrase modification, sequence distance, and structural similarity.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SYNLE
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean number of non-punctuation words preceding a sentence's syntactic main predicate.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SYNNP
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean number of modifiers per noun phrase.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SYNMEDpos
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean normalized minimum edit distance between the part-of-speech sequences of adjacent sentences.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SYNMEDwrd
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean normalized minimum edit distance between the word sequences of adjacent sentences.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SYNMEDlem
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean normalized minimum edit distance between the lemma sequences of adjacent sentences.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SYNSTRUTa
typeDescription.description: Approximates Coh-Metrix parse-tree similarity between adjacent sentences using hierarchical dependency trees.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SYNSTRUTt
typeDescription.description: Approximates global Coh-Metrix parse-tree similarity using hierarchical dependency trees across sentences from different paragraphs.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.SyntacticPatternDensityIndex
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of syntactic constructions such as phrases, passives, negation, gerunds, and infinitives.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DRNP
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of noun phrases per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DRVP
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of verbal projections per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DRAP
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of adverbial-phrase approximations per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DRPP
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of prepositions or prepositional-phrase approximations per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DRPVAL
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of sentences containing a passive construction per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DRNEG
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of negation expressions per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DRGERUND
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of English VBG forms per 1,000 non-punctuation words as an approximation of the Coh-Metrix gerund and -ing category.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.DRINF
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of infinitive forms per 1,000 non-punctuation words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WordInformationIndex
typeDescription.description: Reports grammatical, frequency-based, psycholinguistic, and semantic properties of words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDNOUN
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of nouns per 1,000 words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDVERB
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of verbs per 1,000 words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDADJ
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of adjectives per 1,000 words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDADV
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of adverbs per 1,000 words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDPRO
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of all pronouns per 1,000 words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDPRP1s
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of first-person singular pronouns per 1,000 words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDPRP1p
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of first-person plural pronouns per 1,000 words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDPRP2
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of second-person pronouns per 1,000 words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDPRP3s
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of third-person singular pronouns per 1,000 words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDPRP3p
typeDescription.description: Reports the incidence of third-person plural pronouns per 1,000 words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDFRQc
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean corpus frequency of covered content words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDFRQa
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean logarithmic corpus frequency of covered words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDFRQmc
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean minimum logarithmic corpus frequency of covered content words across sentences.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDAOAc
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean age-of-acquisition rating of covered content words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDFAMc
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean familiarity rating of covered content words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDCNCc
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean concreteness rating of covered content words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDIMGc
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean imageability rating of covered content words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDMEAc
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean meaningfulness rating of covered content words.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDPOLc
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean number of lexical meanings or synsets for covered content-word lemmas.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDHYPn
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean maximum hypernym depth of covered noun lemmas.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDHYPv
typeDescription.description: Reports the mean maximum hypernym depth of covered verb lemmas.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.WRDHYPnv
typeDescription.description: Reports the combined mean hypernym depth of covered noun and verb lemmas.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.ReadabilityIndex
typeDescription.description: Reports traditional readability formulas and the Coh-Metrix second-language readability score.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDL2
typeDescription.description: Reports the Coh-Metrix second-language readability score based on word concreteness, syntactic similarity, and content-word overlap.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDFRE
typeDescription.description: Reports the Flesch Reading Ease score of the raw text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDFKGL
typeDescription.description: Reports the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level score of the raw text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDFOG_textstat
typeDescription.description: Reports the Gunning Fog Index of the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDSMOG_textstat
typeDescription.description: Reports the Simple Measure of Gobbledygook index of the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDARI_textstat
typeDescription.description: Reports the Automated Readability Index of the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDCLI_textstat
typeDescription.description: Reports the Coleman-Liau Index of the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDLW_textstat
typeDescription.description: Reports the Linsear Write Formula score of the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDDCRS_textstat
typeDescription.description: Reports the Dale-Chall Readability Score of the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDSPACHE_textstat
typeDescription.description: Reports the Spache Readability Formula score of the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDWSTF1_textstat
typeDescription.description: Reports variant 1 of the Wiener Sachtextformel for the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDWSTF2_textstat
typeDescription.description: Reports variant 2 of the Wiener Sachtextformel for the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDWSTF3_textstat
typeDescription.description: Reports variant 3 of the Wiener Sachtextformel for the text.

typeDescription.name: org.texttechnologylab.uima.type.cohmetrix.RDWSTF4_textstat
typeDescription.description: Reports variant 4 of the Wiener Sachtextformel for the text.
